text_en: The Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext Index each fell more than 2%, with nearly 5,200 stocks declining across the market. The Hang Seng Index fell 0.85% at midday, while the Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 0.79%, with MINIMAX down more than 8%. Report: The Bank of Japan is preparing to raise rates at next week's policy meeting, most likely by 25 basis points, or may signal readiness to accelerate the pace of rate hikes. Report: Saudi Crown Prince called Trump twice on Thursday to urge strikes on the Houthis, but Trump refused. Report: Iran and Gulf states will meet on Monday to push for a deal on the Strait of Hormuz. Trump: Not worried that AI will cause human extinction. Sam Altman tells employees: OpenAI is open to slowing the pace of developing top-tier AI.
